description: This file defines Swagger API response schemas for journal entries related operations in the Apache Fineract project. It contains annotated classes representing response data structures used for API documentation and serialization.

classes.name: JournalEntriesApiResourceSwagger.PostJournalEntriesResponse
classes.description: Response structure for a posted journal entry, including office ID and transaction ID.

classes.name: JournalEntriesApiResourceSwagger.PostJournalEntriesTransactionIdRequest
classes.description: Request structure for transaction ID related operations, specifying the office ID.

classes.name: JournalEntriesApiResourceSwagger.PostJournalEntriesTransactionIdResponse
classes.description: Response structure for transaction ID operations, indicating the office ID.

classes.name: JournalEntriesApiResourceSwagger.CurrencyItem
classes.description: Represents currency details such as code, name, display symbol, and other related info.

classes.name: JournalEntriesApiResourceSwagger.EnumOptionType
classes.description: Enumerates account or transaction types with id, code, and value.

classes.name: JournalEntriesApiResourceSwagger.JournalEntryTransactionItem
classes.description: Details of a journal entry transaction, including IDs, account info, transaction date, amount, balances, and nested details.

classes.name: JournalEntriesApiResourceSwagger.JournalEntryTransactionItem.PaymentDetailData
classes.description: Payment details associated with a transaction, including method type, account info, check, and routing details.

classes.name: JournalEntriesApiResourceSwagger.JournalEntryTransactionItem.TransactionDetails
classes.description: Further details about the transaction, including ID, type, notes, and payment info.

classes.name: JournalEntriesApiResourceSwagger.GetJournalEntriesTransactionIdResponse
classes.description: Contains total record count and list of journal entry transaction items.

methods.name: JournalEntriesApiResourceSwagger.PostJournalEntriesResponse
methods.description: Schema for the response after posting journal entries.

methods.name: JournalEntriesApiResourceSwagger.PostJournalEntriesTransactionIdRequest
methods.description: Schema for requesting a transaction ID, includes office context.

methods.name: JournalEntriesApiResourceSwagger.PostJournalEntriesTransactionIdResponse
methods.description: Schema for response containing transaction ID-related info.

methods.name: JournalEntriesApiResourceSwagger.EnumOptionType
methods.description: Schema for enumerated types with ID, code, and value.

methods.name: JournalEntriesApiResourceSwagger.JournalEntryTransactionItem
methods.description: Schema capturing details of individual journal entry transactions.

methods.name: JournalEntriesApiResourceSwagger.JournalEntryTransactionItem.PaymentDetailData
methods.description: Details about payment method and identifiers.

methods.name: JournalEntriesApiResourceSwagger.JournalEntryTransactionItem.TransactionDetails
methods.description: Additional transaction specifics, linking to notes and payment info.

methods.name: JournalEntriesApiResourceSwagger.GetJournalEntriesTransactionIdResponse
methods.description: Aggregates response data for transactions list.
